text: ポケモンが　いっきに　そだって　レベルが　あがる　らしいの

structure.jp: ポケモンが　いっきに　そだって
structure.en: the Pokémon grows all at once, and

structure.jp: レベルが　あがる　らしいの

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい after a verb says this is what you have heard, not something you know yourself. あがる　らしい = 'apparently it goes up'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て ending joins one happening to the next, like 'and'. そだって = 'it grows, and'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is a soft version of のだ, used mostly by women and children when telling you how things are. らしいの = 'apparently, you see'.
